workstreams.title: Reference identity and benchmark integrity
workstreams.acceptance: Each named benchmark matches the actual specification; substitute analytic/manufactured cases have distinct IDs and original cases remain open until genuinely run.

workstreams.title: Capability inventory and reproducible baseline
workstreams.acceptance: Every advertised operation has an inspected engine-to-UI/persistence path, exact availability state, validity bounds and reproduced baseline command exits.

workstreams.title: Unified adapters, jobs and IPC
workstreams.acceptance: Operation contracts, adapter dispatch, worker lifecycle, cancellation, error propagation, units and result provenance are verified through public entry points.

workstreams.title: Sparse/native kernels and resource isolation
workstreams.acceptance: SPD/indefinite/nonsymmetric systems use valid methods with bounded fallback; real backend, residuals, memory and representative performance are measured.

workstreams.title: B-Rep kernel and geometry operations
workstreams.acceptance: Pinned licensed B-Rep backend executes required features with manifold/orientation/tolerance/volume and independent geometry verification.

workstreams.title: CAD exchange, constraints and topology history
workstreams.acceptance: External-reader exchange round trips and feature re-evaluation preserve intended topology, assembly units/transforms and constraint diagnostics.

workstreams.title: Structural continuum and constitutive verification
workstreams.acceptance: Element patch/objectivity/scaling tests, quadrature, residuals, tangents and convergence hold for declared linear/nonlinear formulations and actual reference cases.

workstreams.title: Discrete contact, modal and explicit dynamics
workstreams.acceptance: Actual discretized contact/mass/time integration produce independently checked pressure/modes/energy; reduced-dimensional methods retain accurate capability labels.

workstreams.title: Conservative laminar FVM and pressure coupling
workstreams.acceptance: Closed face topology, normal signs, density/diffusion scaling, stable pressure coupling and conservation pass constant-flow, manufactured and channel studies without masking NaNs.

workstreams.title: Implicit SST RANS and NASA reference closure
workstreams.acceptance: Selected SST equations and wall treatment reproduce the actual NASA setup with predeclared stationarity/grid/conservation studies and unchanged reference tolerances.

workstreams.title: Thermal, VOF and rotating-flow fidelity
workstreams.acceptance: Thermal coupling and requested interface/rotating formulations conserve appropriate quantities; prescribed advection and Euler stage estimates are not relabeled as coupled 3D solvers.

workstreams.title: Liberty/CCS/MCMM timing and synthesis
workstreams.acceptance: Sourced timing tables, graph propagation, corners/modes and waveform extraction match independent reference decks through production contracts.

workstreams.title: Nonlinear circuits and physical EDA exchange
workstreams.acceptance: Real compact-model backend and exchange/parser/DRC/LVS workflows pass independent netlists/layouts; unsupported devices and malformed files fail closed.

workstreams.title: Ray/wave optics and material provenance
workstreams.acceptance: Geometric and wave engines satisfy energy/Snell/TIR/FFT checks and independent optical systems using source-reviewed, licensed dispersion/tolerance data.

workstreams.title: Thermodynamics, flash and IF97
workstreams.acceptance: Explicit sourced compositions/properties satisfy material/fugacity/energy balances, all claimed IF97 regions and published boundary/reference states.

workstreams.title: Columns, recycle, piping and process transients
workstreams.acceptance: Actual unit-operation/column/recycle/transient equations close their balances and execute validated input contracts without invented evaluators or code allowables.

workstreams.title: DAE, system semantics and verified code generation
workstreams.acceptance: Residual-form DAE initialization/index bounds, chart events/concurrency, FMU lifecycle and generated target behavior have reference and compiler/static-analysis evidence.

workstreams.title: P&ID authoring and drawing integrity
workstreams.acceptance: Editable persisted project basis, clipping-free pagination, off-page connectivity, schematic NTS labeling, readable print exports and engineer-reviewed tag/schedule consistency.

workstreams.title: Professional engineering UI and accessibility
workstreams.acceptance: Packaged task-based workflows cover selection/edit/undo/save/export/cancel/error/recovery, keyboard/accessibility, latency and no inert or synthetic-result controls.

workstreams.title: Project durability and transactional storage
workstreams.acceptance: Actual UI project round trips, concurrent archives, torn writes, restart and interrupted job recovery preserve committed data with bounded streaming memory.

workstreams.title: Authenticated HPC, identity and audit provenance
workstreams.acceptance: Real configured providers authenticate submit/poll/cancel and verify artifacts/signatures/timestamps; prepared scripts and local acknowledgements never claim remote execution.

workstreams.title: Supported runtime, packaging and dependency security
workstreams.acceptance: Explicit supported deployment matrix, runtime advisory resolution, clean installs, signed packages where required, affirmative bounded smoke and update/rollback evidence.

workstreams.title: Release gates, coverage and independent review
workstreams.acceptance: Actual failures propagate through CI and coverage; counts are finite/exact, whole scope is inventoried, references remain independent and evidence is reproducible.

workstreams.title: Performance, soak and workflow-specific release qualification
workstreams.acceptance: Ratified performance/soak, traceable domain evidence and independent owner acceptance close the finite release manifest without blanket self-certification.
